item.title: 5 villagers missing in a flooded Laos cave for more than a week have been found alive
item.description: Five villagers trapped in a flooded cave in central Laos for over a week have been found alive

item.title: North Korea says it tested new warheads, technology and navigation in latest launches
item.description: North Korea says its latest launches involved multiple weapons systems, including a nuclear-capable cruise missile that leader Kim Jong Un plans to deploy with front-line units facing South Korea

item.title: Berlin police arrest man suspected of being an accomplice to Holocaust Memorial stabbing
item.description: An alleged accomplice of a man who was convicted of stabbing and seriously wounding a Spanish tourist at Berlin’s Holocaust Memorial last year has been arrested in the German capital

item.title: Chief of communications intel agency says Russia is relentlessly targeting UK
item.description: A U.K. spy chief is warning that Britain and its allies risk losing a cyber conflict against adversaries like Russia unless cybersecurity is treated with greater urgency
